note: Only used by the updater to copy existing device state locally. No directory from a device is accepted as a build input. OpenClash core and root-level package databases are deliberately excluded from migration. Tailscale uses /etc/tailscale/tailscaled.state; daed uses /etc/daed including wing.db and WAL. Nonstandard storage paths need explicit review. /var -> tmp is runtime state, including nlbwmon's database, not persistent storage. ZeroTier's UCI identity remains in the existing etc/config keep list.
